name: mcp-index-builder
description: Pinned toolchain for the MCP search-index workflow, isolated from the root package.json (which needs token-gated GitHub Packages). @qvac/sdk, its embedder and @qvac/fabric (the llama.cpp build the embedder links against) must match the versions the search service locks, or index and query vectors come from different llama.cpp builds. tsx here runs the builder; the corpus generator's own deps (tsx, github-slugger) are pinned separately in scripts/mcp-corpus.
